description: This file provides utility functions for adding and managing annotations (such as labels and markers) on Plotly charts within a React-based frontend application. It includes functions to add, plot, initialize, and handle interactions with annotations on financial/stock charts.

methods.name: plot_text
methods.description: Plots a text annotation on the chart, computing appropriate y-offset based on axis range, and either adds a new annotation or updates an existing one.

methods.name: init_annotation
methods.description: Initializes annotation interactions, including setting click handlers for adding, editing, and removing annotations, and managing related state updates within a React component context.
